scenes.title:
Tools shaped
by you.
scenes.narration: Describe a small application. Review its behavior. Use it inside RAI-OS.

scenes.title:
A request becomes
an application.
scenes.narration: Meta generated fields and a balance formula for a repair workshop. One recorded request: 5.518 seconds provider time.

scenes.title:
Review the process.
Then install.
scenes.narration: The model defines stages and actions. Rust validates the proposal. The user reviews fields and rules before installation.

scenes.title:
Not paid?
Not delivered.
scenes.narration: This repair is done, but its balance is 4000 cents. The declared delivery rule blocks the action without changing the order.

scenes.title:
Record payment.
Deliver locally.
scenes.narration: Payment changes the balance to zero. Delivery succeeds. Ordinary edits are now locked. No inference for these actions.

scenes.title:
Your tool
can evolve.
scenes.narration: Separate recorded example: a second prompt added cost and profit to a quoting app while preserving its original records.

scenes.title:
Change the cost.
Keep the logic.
scenes.narration: Increase one cost from 150 to 175 cents. Total profit changes from 285 to 260 locally. The workshop stays unchanged.

scenes.title:
Restart.
Keep your work.
scenes.narration: Both apps, their records and process states recover after a fresh QEMU boot. Persistence uses an explicit host checkpoint.

scenes.title:
Small kernel.
Explicit boundaries.
scenes.narration: Rust guest: validation, execution, graphics. Host: HTTPS, input, saved sessions. Apps currently share EL1 privilege.

scenes.title:
Run it.
Create your own.
scenes.narration: Try the saved apps without a key. Use your own Meta key for new supported tools. Native code and physical phones remain future work.
